_comments: Runs the Sweep Contract Renewal Terms action daily at 01:30 UTC, ahead of the renewal pass.
· ConcurrencyMode Skip: two runs would save the same subscriptions.
· MissedRunPolicy RunOnce: each run re-reads every link, so one catch-up covers any gap.
Seeded Active: it only touches subscriptions of orders explicitly linked to a contract.

fields.Name: Contracts — Copy Renewal Terms to Subscriptions (daily)
fields.Description: Copies each linked contract's annual increase and carry-discount flag to the subscriptions its orders created, including subscriptions created after the link.
